name: Preciosura
description: Uruguayan online store for perfumes (Arabic, designer, niche), makeup, hair and body care, and mate items. Ships nationwide by DAC and offers pickup at two Montevideo points; orders are made to order in about 3 to 7 business days.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de perfumes (árabes, diseñador, nicho), maquillaje, cuidado capilar y corporal y artículos para mate. Envía a todo el país por DAC y ofrece retiro en dos puntos de Montevideo; pedidos por encargo de 3 a 7 días hábiles.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide by DAC; tracking number sent by email

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at two Montevideo points (Camino Carrasco and Avenida Italia); show the confirmation email

shopping_notes: Shipping and FAQ text is on the home page; no separate shipping page. Cart at /carrito, checkout at /finalizar-compra. Also sells its own SELECT line.

sources.supports: home page: categories, nationwide DAC shipping, pickup points, lead times, cart
